This document details the items, which are checked daily or weekly or monthly as 
recommended and defined in Mitsubishi catalogs. This inspection is visual 
inspection during the site touring. There is no need to open the doors or covers 
of the operating mechanism housing and control cabinet for this inspection. If 
the sf6 gas low pressure alarm is given, SF6 gas should be supplied until the 
gas pressure reach the rated value. Sf6 gas can be supplied even with the breaker energized.

Kamel Mahmoud, revised by UEEPC quality control general director eng. Gamal 
Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kuriemat power station.

Introduction
This document details the items, which are checked daily or weekly or monthly as 
recommended and defined in Mitsubishi catalogs. This inspection is visual 
inspection during the site touring. There is no need to open the doors or covers 
of the operating mechanism housing and control cabinet for this inspection. If 
the sf6 gas low pressure alarm is given, SF6 gas should be supplied until the 
gas pressure reach the rated value. Sf6 gas can be supplied even with the breaker energized.
The first draft initiated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar, tested by eng. Nafad 
Kamel Mahmoud, revised by UEEPC quality control general director eng. Gamal 
Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kuriemat power station.
